purpose: Structural group of Speaker instances with one parent transform and editable member-local transforms

data.name: string
data.type: generic | line-array | cluster | sub-array | stack | distributed

rules: a set is a group of real Speaker instances rather than a replacement speaker model
all members remain independently addressable for acoustic calculation
moving or rotating the set changes every member world transform without rewriting member-local transforms
set type selects editor helpers and topology semantics but does not create a separate acoustic solver
line arrays and clusters are represented through SpeakerSet rather than encoded as special SpeakerModel instances
nested sets are not required by this contract
